items.q: Can my partner access it too?
items.a: Of course. You share the same space, you edit together, in real time.

items.q: Can I share with my witnesses or family?
items.a: Yes. The wedding-day plan and some views are shareable via a simple link.

items.q: Do I need to download an app?
items.a: No. Mariable works directly in your browser — computer, tablet or mobile. No download via Apple or Google Store, but a tutorial to display the app as a shortcut on your phone screen is available in your space!
